name: Radiant Requiem of Destruction
name_jp: 耀光崩界のレクイエム
effects:
7 single-target Dark/NE summon magic attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Lv.3 En-Dark, En-Dark Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Dark Damage +20%, Magic Casting Speed x1.1 & chases 3 Dark abilities with single-target Imperil Dark 30% for 5 seconds and grants Dualcast Dark 1 to user (max 1 chase)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Dark, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Anima's Pain+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
